name: Record Atlas
tagline: Every place your people came from, and who holds the paper

ads.note: Off until an ad unit exists. `client` is already declared in ads.txt at https://daviddef.github.io/ads.txt, which is why this site can carry ads at all from a github.io address — ads.txt must live at the root of the DOMAIN, and that one does. `slot` comes from AdSense: Ads > By ad unit > Display ads. Nothing here is secret; both values are visible in any page's source. Turning `enabled` on before a consent banner is live would be a policy breach in the EEA and the UK, which is most of this audience.
